Empire]] *[[New Republic]] }} {{Quote|That's for Hosnian Prime!|A Resistance pilot after destroying an enemy fighter|''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''}} '''Hosnian Prime''' was a [[planet]] in the [[Hosnian system]] of the [[Core Worlds]], located along the [[Corellian Trade Spine]]. By [[28 ABY]], it served as the [[capital]] of the [[New Republic]] and the headquarters of the [[New Republic Senate]]. In [[34 ABY]] during the [[Cold War]] with the [[First Order]], that sought to rid [[the galaxy]] of the New Republic which it saw as illegitimate, the First Order used its [[superweapon]], [[Starkiller Base]], to [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destroy]] Hosnian Prime and all other planetary bodies in the [[Star system|system]]. The superweapon caused the ignition of Hosnian Prime's core, transforming the planet into a [[star]] in a [[pocket nova]]. ==Description== Hosnian Prime was a cosmopolitan [[Planet|world]]{{Databank|hosnian-prime|Hosnian Prime}} located in the [[Hosnian system]], on the edge of the [[Core Worlds]]. It lay in grid square M-12 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]] and was located along the [[Corellian Trade Spine]]. Hosnian Prime shared its name with [[Hosnian Gravity Parks]].''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]'' ==History== ===The Great "Peace"=== {{Quote|But there's no slavery on Hosnian Prime.''"
"''Of course not. The Republic doesn't allow slavery. They ''do'' allow Czerka Corporation to do business, though, and naturally Czerka can bring in whatever workers it wants.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Pax Maripher]]|}} Hosnian Prime was a planet with a politically-minded culture that was a member of the [[Galactic Republic]]. By the [[High Republic Era]], the planet had a reputation for its political intrigues''[[The High Republic: Defy the Storm]]'' and boasted [[Republic shipyards|shipyards]] that produced [[Starship|vessels]] for the Republic, such as the [[Longbeam-class corvette|''Longbeam''-class corvette]] ''[[Aurora IX]]''. During the [[Nihil conflict]], it was represented by the well-respected [[Ghirra Starros]], who secretly became an [[agent]] of [[Eye of the Nihil]] [[Marchion Ro]],{{Databank|ghirra-starros|Ghirra Starros}} in order to play both sides of the Republic-[[Nihil]] conflict so as to retain her power.''[[The High Republic: The Fallen Star]]'' By the [[Republic Era|waning]] [[Standard year|years]] of the Republic, Hosnian Prime hosted a [[Hosnian Prime factory complex|factory complex]] run by [[Czerka Arms]], an arms manufacturer whose activities included the use of [[slavery]]. [[Rahara Wick]] was [[Reproduction|born]] into slavery on the planet, working in [[Mining|mines]] deep underneath the surface. ===Age of the Empire=== {{Dialogue|Mozeen Parapa|My tech-masters tracked thee signal toah Freerago's.|Han Solo|The diner orbiting Hosnian Prime? That seems…random.|Sana Starros|Whoever has the Phylanx must be holed up there to keep a low profile and plot their next move. We can stake it out in shifts.|attr=Mozeen Parapa, Han Solo, and Sana Starros discuss Parapa's last tracked signal of the Phylanx Redux Transmitter|src=''[[Last Shot]]''}} During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], [[Plas Lelkot]], the [[surgeon consul]] of Hosnian Prime, hid [[refugee]]s in his own [[Plas Lelkot's chateau|chateau]]. Due to his support for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], he was [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] at the bleak [[Ashmead's Lock]] [[prison]] on the planet [[Kashyyyk]]. Between [[12 BBY]] and [[11 BBY]], the [[Inquisitor]] known as the [[Fifth Brother]] faced [[Jedi Knight]] [[Cal Kestis]] and [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] [[Merrin]] on Hosnian Prime.''[[Star Wars Jedi: Battle Scars]]'' Around [[3 BBY]], [[Han Solo]] had a run-in with [[Torrian]] security guards on Hosnian Prime which left a [[Color|purplish]] stain on his shirt. Not long after, Solo and [[Chewbacca]] went to the [[Freerago's Satellite Diner and Motel]], a satellite diner and motel in [[orbit]] of Hosnian Prime, to retrieve a device known as the [[Phylanx Redux Transmitter]] for the [[crime lord]] [[Mozeen Parapa]]. The pair were successful in their attempts, with help from the [[bounty hunter]] [[Sana Starros]]. After returning to Imperial space following the [[Battle of Yavin]], Imperial [[Senior Lieutenant]] [[Iden Versio]] debriefed and spent [[time]] on Hosnian Prime recovering from injuries she suffered after her [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighter]] was damaged in the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star's]] explosion before crash landing on [[Yavin Prime|Yavin's]] [[Yavin 4|fourth]] [[moon]].''[[Battlefront II: Inferno Squad]]'' ===New Republic Era=== {{Quote|A mouse droid tells me that the New Republic is setting up a new flight academy on Hosnian Prime. And I hear you'll be a pupil there, is that right?|[[Conder Kyl]], to Temmin Wexley|}} [[File:HS-orbital-outpost.png|thumb|left|200px|Titan Squadron extract Agent Thorn from an orbital outpost]] Imperial [[Captain]] [[Terisa Kerrill]] later sent [[Titan Squadron]] to [[Mission to Hosnian Prime|retrieve]] [[Agent]] [[Thorn (Galactic Empire)|Thorn]] from an [[Hosnian Prime orbital outpost|orbital outpost]] above the planet. After a successful rescue, Thorn revealed the location of a New Republic convoy near [[Desevro]] carrying workers for [[Project Starhawk]]. In [[5 ABY]], the Rebel Alliance's successor government, the [[New Republic]], operated a [[Unidentified New Republic veteran hospital|veteran hospital]] in [[Darropolis]]. There, the [[New Republic soldier]] [[Dade Hetkins]] received treatment and a [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] [[Limb|leg]] to replace the one lost following the [[Battle of Endor]]. [[Doctor]] [[Arsad]] supervised Hetkins' recovery and assigned him the prototype [[therapy droid]] [[QT-9]]. Around the time of the [[Battle of Jakku]], [[Yuprin Arlo]] [[Senator|represented]] Hosnian Prime in the New Republic's [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]]. Another native of Hosnian Prime, [[Sondiv Sella]], served as a [[Councillor|councilman]] in the Senate. [[File:Republic_City_Hosnian_Prime.png|thumb|right|300px|Republic City was the capital of Hosnian Prime, and therefore, the New Republic seat of government.]] Following the Battle of [[Jakku]], the New Republic set up a [[Hosnian Prime flight academy|flight academy]] on Hosnian Prime. [[Wedge Antilles]], a [[New Republic pilot]] was made its head instructor and offered a job as an instructor to [[Norra Wexley]], who accepted. Norra's son, [[Temmin Wexley]], was also to attend the academy as a pupil. By [[28 ABY]],{{Twitter|DelReyStarWars|status/652893780236988420|[[Del Rey]]|quote=So excited to have @claudiagray writing a #StarWars novel with us. SW: New Republic: Bloodline coming 2016. Set 6 years before TFA.|archivefile=File:New Republic Bloodline Twitter Post.jpg}} establishes that the events of [[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']] take place six [[Standard year|years]] before the events of {{Film|VII}}. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''The Force Awakens'' to [[34 ABY]], so ''Bloodline'' must take place in [[28 ABY]]. Hosnian Prime had been voted the [[capital]] of the New Republic, and hosted individuals from many [[species]] including [[human]]s, [[Wookiee]]s, and [[Gungan]]s. By that stage, two major factions had emerged in the Senate: the [[Populists]], who wanted worlds to maintain considerable autonomy; and the [[Centrists]], who favored a stronger central government. That year, the [[New Republic senatorial complex|senatorial complex]] was damaged during the [[Napkin Bombing]]. The [[bomb]] had been planted by [[Arliz Hadrassian]], a former Imperial [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilot]] and [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[officer]] who had become the leader of the [[Amaxine warriors (New Republic Era)|Amaxine warriors]], a militia that served as a front for the [[First Order]], a remnant of the Old Empire. It was on Hosnian Prime that Populist Senator [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa's]] true [[parent]]age as the daughter of [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] was revealed. This information was publicly disclosed by her Centrist friend senator [[Ransolm Casterfo]], who had been manipulated by [[Lady]] [[Carise Sindian]], a secret [[agent]] of the First Order. The Populist Senator [[Tai-Lin Garr]] was later [[Tai-Lin Garr's assassination|assassinated]] by Hadrassian while campaigning as [[First Senator]] in one of Hosnian Prime's parks. Sindian later framed Casterfo for the crime after he supported Organa's report about the existence of threats to the New Republic. Organa subsequently announced her intention to resign from the Senate and founded the [[Resistance]], a private military force dedicated to protecting the Republic. In [[29 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' states that [[BB-8]] was manufactured five [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. Therefore, BB-8 was manufactured in [[29 ABY]]. the [[droid]] [[BB-8]] was built on Hosnian Prime.''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' ===Hosnian Cataclysm=== {{Quote|All remaining systems will bow before the First Order and will remember this as the last day of the Republic.|First Order General [[Armitage Hux]]|}} [[File:DestructionoftheHosniansystem.png|thumb|left|300px|The First Order destroyed Hosnian Prime, and along with it, the New Republic.]] In [[34 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' the First Order, believing the Republic to be an illegitimate government incapable of maintaining order in the [[galaxy]], targeted the Republic-controlled Hosnian system with a [[superweapon]] known as [[Starkiller Base]] in an effort to destroy them. The Starkiller turned its sights towards Hosnian Prime and [[Hosnian Cataclysm|incinerated]] them with a beam of [[phantom energy]]. [[Chancellor (New Republic)|Chancellor]] [[Lanever Villecham]], Resistance [[commander]] [[Korr Sella]], countless senators, and all the inhabitants of the Hosnian [[Star system|system]] were [[Death|victims]] in the destruction of the system. In the resulting [[pocket nova]], Hosnian Prime became a second [[star]] in its system. ==Inhabitants== Hosnian Prime's inhabitants celebrated [[Equinox Day]], a holiday unique to the planet commemorating the beginning of [[autumn]]. By the High Republic Era, Hosnian Prime was considered a center of style and elegance that was second only to the Republic capital of Coruscant in terms of political intrigue, as well as for backstabbing. It was the planet that produced Ghirra Starros, a major political actor during the Nihil conflict[[The High Republic – Shadows of Starlight 4|''The High Republic – Shadows of Starlight'' 4]] whose allegiance to Marchion Ro seemed to usher in a Nihil-supporting era on Hosnian Prime, even despite its position in the Core. Afterward, however, the planet would return to its Republic loyalties and even serve as a major baston for the New Republic. ==Locations== [[File:Exantor_Divo_graduation.jpg|thumb|right|220px|A graduation ceremony of the Hosnian Prime Academy of Law Enforcement]] [[City|Cities]] on Hosnian Prime included its capital [[Republic City]] and Darropolis. Besides the New Republic senatorial complex, other locations on Hosnian Prime included the [[hanging gardens]], the [[Offices of the Galaxy Beacon|offices of the ''Galaxy Beacon'']], and the [[Hosnian Prime Academy of Law Enforcement]]. [[Caf bean]]s were roasted at gourmet artisanal [[Factory|factories]] on Hosnian Prime by [[Culinary septoid droid|culinary droids]]. ==Behind the scenes== Hosnian Prime was created for the [[2015]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]]. Information about the planet and its status within the New Republic was elaborated upon in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''. During the development of Episode VII, some individuals at [[Bad Robot Productions]] wanted the planet destroyed in the film to be [[Coruscant]], the galaxy's galactic capital that featured heavily in the ''Star Wars'' [[prequel trilogy]]. According to [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Pablo Hidalgo]], representatives of [[Lucasfilm]] were reticent to this idea, since Coruscant was planned to appear in other projects besides ''The Force Awakens''. As a compromise, Hosnian Prime was created to fill the role of the New Republic capital.{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1481688997571088385|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Basically BR wanted it blown up; LFL didn't. Hosnian Prime was the unsatisfying middle ground. It happens.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/jDWgX}}{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1481757620830539778|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=It would have been better w/o the Starkiller at all, but that's a whole nother discussion. But I think Coruscant being in development in other projects was a big reason for the reticence.|archiveurl=https://archive.fo/BOokJ}} In a different tweet, Hidalgo explained that the destruction of the Hosnian system was visible from across the galaxy because of the vast quantities of energy released from Starkiller Base creating a temporary rip in [[sub-hyperspace]].{{Twitter|PabloHidalgo|status/677919736873684992|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=@Thimburd What they're seeing is some weird hand-wavy hyperspace rip. Side-effect of the Starkiller.|nobackup=1}} ''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'' mistakenly refers to Hosnian Prime as "Hosnia" in one instance.''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]''
